items.title: Cosimo Matassa Interview, 1993-07-17
items.q: Well, that's what I mean, knowing them early on, you know.

ctx.x: They started out of a shoebox. Wait a minute.

Yeah, right. Well, that's what I mean, knowing them early on, you know. So they came down, they gave nominal royalties. Mm-hmm. They had publishing companies, and they took publishing routinely and didn't compensate people. They paid you a little money on publishing, but not a great deal. And that sort of thing. And the ones that I recall as being extremely difficult to deal with would be, say, what was the guy that had King Records? Sid Nathan? Sid Nathan. Oh, okay. Yeah.
Tough to do business with. He had a guy, his lawyer, Jack Pearl. Mm-hmm, right. You know, Jack Pearl was one of the big heavies in the industry at that time.
